name: bracket
title: Bracket bench: optimised bracket
description: Bracket B (and C, the variant printable): the stiffest bracket of the same mass the optimiser finds for the bench's load (problems/bracket.json); for C, only what prints without supports standing on its back plate. Variant side (D): only what prints without supports lying on its side; side-free: B laid on its side, to show what it would need supporting.
orientation: B and C: standing on their back plate, as optimised. D: lying on its side, its bottom edge on the bed (the problem's y up). 100% infill, 0.2 mm layers, the same filament as the other brackets.

problem.rule: The optimisation problem: free, or printable without supports standing up (bracket:printable) or lying on its side (bracket:side)

target.rule: Every bracket's volume: the same share of the envelope
target.label: Volume

smooth.rule: Segments in each round boss and hole

side.rule: 1: drawn lying on its side, the problem's y up
